propositions: Cumulative error counter blocks in observability.sh advance their offset file before CloudWatch acknowledges the put-metric-data call, causing transient AWS failures to permanently lose the interval's count
Seven metric streams across six code shapes (replication, voter, merge-change, deploy, shared helpers, G2P) all exhibit the same defect of acknowledging offsets before successful publication
A failed put-metric-data call followed by a successful retry publishes zero instead of the accumulated delta because the offset has already advanced past the failure interval
The fix must reorder each of the six concrete publish shapes so offset advances only after successful CloudWatch publication, while preserving systemd exit-0 contract and existing logging behavior
Regression test must prove offset remains byte-identical after AWS failure, accumulated delta publishes on successful retry, and offset advances only after that success
Reset handling and zero-delta publication behavior must remain unchanged and compatible with the offset-acknowledgement repair
